description: Use this for an existing source+id, including an entity record or confirmed link; do not repeat a broad search. Fetch only needed records; selectively fetch supplied URLs with host web tools if more page content is needed. Fetch one product record from openFDA, DSLD, DailyMed, or INKEEDecoder. The `id` is the database's own key: a product NDC (openFDA), a numeric label id (DSLD), an SPL set id (DailyMed), or a product slug/URL (INKEEDecoder). The result carries the unified product ref, source-specific details, ingredient rows (roles, quantities, UNIIs when supplied by the source), links, and suggested follow-up calls. openFDA directory ingredient rows may lack identifiers. For SPL label UNIIs use drugdata_resolve_identifiers with include_label_ingredients: true. `include_ingredients` is true by default; false also skips DSLD ingredient mapping and enrichment. `include_ingredient_enrichment` adds DSLD nutrient CAS/group metadata with up to 20 extra serial requests, default false; it has no effect when ingredients are omitted. `include_label_sections` extracts DailyMed SPL usage sections — these are large and default false. `page` pages the ingredient and label-section collections one page at a time and re-fetches the record; it never walks pages automatically. A malformed id is an error result naming the search tool that finds a valid one; an upstream miss is an error result, not an empty product.

id.description: The database's own identifier: product NDC (openfda), numeric label id (dsld), SPL set id (dailymed), or slug/URL (inkeedecoder).

include_ingredient_enrichment.description: Add DSLD nutrient CAS/group metadata with up to 20 extra serial requests. Default false. Applies only to dsld when include_ingredients is true; ignored for other sources and when ingredients are omitted.

include_ingredients.description: Include the product's ingredient rows with roles, quantities, and UNIIs when supplied by the source. openFDA directory rows may lack identifiers; use drugdata_resolve_identifiers with include_label_ingredients: true for SPL label UNIIs. Default true.

include_label_sections.description: Extract DailyMed SPL usage sections (dosage, directions, patient guidance). Large — default false. Applies to dailymed products; false omits the sections and does not run the section parser.

page.description: Page number for ingredient and label-section collections, starting at 1. One page per call; the record is re-fetched and the tool never walks pages automatically.

response_format.description: Text format: 'markdown' for a readable record, or 'json' for the structured result serialized as JSON.

source.description: Upstream database that owns the record: 'openfda', 'dsld', 'dailymed', or 'inkeedecoder'.
